policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
            var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? string.Empty;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(body)) { return string.Empty; }
            try
            {
                var payload = Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(body);
                return (string)(payload["model"] ?? payload["deployment"] ?? string.Empty);
            }
            catch
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }
        }" />
